events.summary: Superseded. The v1 pause commitment was never invoked and was replaced in v3.0 with a conditional formulation plus self-graded roadmaps. The company's stated rationale: unilateral pause commitments do not make sense if competitors keep advancing. Whether the replacement framework preserves the original promise's force is the open question the Frontier Safety Roadmap lineage now tracks.

lineages.fulfillmentTest: Under RSP v1, Anthropic pauses scaling and/or delays deployment whenever its scaling ability outstrips its ability to comply with the ASL safety procedures. Result: the binding pause clause was removed in RSP v3.0 (Feb 24, 2026) before ever being invoked - the commitment was superseded, not fulfilled.
lineages.title: Responsible Scaling Policy pause commitment (v1 to v3.0)
